description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionFactoryLoader class, which is a utility class responsible for loading and providing access to a singleton ConnectionFactory instance used for database connections within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryLoader
classes.description: A utility class that loads the ConnectionFactory instance based on configuration and provides a singleton accessor method.

methods.name: createConnectionFactory
methods.description: Private method that loads the ConnectionFactory class dynamically based on configuration, instantiates it, and handles any exceptions related to class loading or instantiation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Public static method to retrieve the singleton ConnectionFactory instance; throws an exception if it has not been initialized.
